verdict.rationale: Discord ships a well-documented official developer platform (REST API, Gateway WebSocket API, OAuth2, webhooks, slash commands, and an official Embedded App SDK for building apps/games) that developers can build against. However, the evidence shows no official first-party SDKs in mainstream languages (e.g., JS/Python) — those are community-maintained — and nothing AI-specific is documented. Missing for 10: officially maintained language SDKs beyond the Embedded App SDK, AI/agent-specific SDK features, independent developer corroboration of SDK quality.
